answer: Bind each new identity to a hardware-rooted attestation: a trusted enclave signs a fresh cipher key, proving one physical device backs the account, and the signature is published like a quartz seal that cannot be copied. One device may mint only a single full-standing identity per season, so a farm needs real hardware, not scripts. A public jade registry lists every attestation, letting anyone spot two identities sharing one enclave key and prune them together. Honest agents keep their standing; fakes become expensive, visible, and easy to remove.
